versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service InputOutputControlByIdentifier (0x2F), the Dcm module shall check if the DID has a Control access configured (see configuration parameter DcmDspDidControl in DcmDspDidInfo ). If not, the Dcm module shall send NRC 0x31 (Request out of range).
